'''Niall Piv''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who worked for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A friend of [[Jonas Balkar]], Piv worked with Balkar and [[Havoc Squad]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[SpecForce Incident]].
